text:
Elena (Product): quick design sync: two small but related asks for the model catalog compare — make filter state more discoverable and add a simple CSV export for compare results.
Marcus (Design): agree. filter state disappears when you reload. proposal: show a compact "Active filters" pill in the header that opens the current filter panel. also add an explicit "Save filters" affordance.
Ravi (Eng): persisting filters is easy-ish: store per-user presets server-side. CSV export is straightforward: server can return a CSV of visible columns for the compare session. need to define which columns are included by default.
Ava (A11y): if we surface an "Active filters" pill, it needs accessible name like "Active filters: 3 applied" and keyboard focus. when the CSV finishes, announce "Download ready" with aria-live.
Jun (Research): users liked quick export when sharing results with stakeholders. they expect columns for model name, pinned version, latency, cost, and quantization. Keep it minimal.
Elena (Product): perfect. keep default CSV columns: name, version, latency_ms, unit_cost, quantization. add a dropdown for advanced export that includes full metadata.
Marcus (Design): UI: small chevron next to pill to open a menu: Save preset, Export CSV, Clear filters. Save modal asks for name + scope. We'll show a small success toast.
Ravi (Eng): API endpoints: POST /presets, GET /presets, GET /compare/export?format=csv&columns=... We'll gate export behind feature flag for initial rollout.
Ava (A11y): Save modal must trap focus; make sure toast is reachable for screen readers. CSV export should be keyboard-triggerable and include a visible progress state.
Jun (Research): I'll run a quick hallway test for discoverability of the Active filters pill and the export flow. target 8 participants.
Elena (Product): metrics: preset_created, preset_applied, export_initiated, export_completed. Aim to ship prototype next week.
Ravi (Eng): will scope out a 4-day spike for API + client work, demo by Thu. adding feature flag "catalog_export".
Marcus (Design): I'll upload mocks with the pill, modal, and CSV dropdown states by EOD tomorrow, include a11y notes.
bot-preview: review app at https://staging.redwood.company/review/5120 — export behind flag catalog_export.
Elena (Product): great teamwork. small nits for PR: tooltip delay 300ms, aria-labels for badges unchanged, and analytics events prefixed with "catalog_". thanks :sparkles:
